title: BBQ Beans
description: A quick barbecue-style baked bean side made with haricot and kidney beans in a smoked paprika and passata sauce.

ingredients.text: 1 × 400g tin haricot beans, drained and rinsed
1 × 400g tin kidney beans, drained and rinsed
1 tsp Henderson’s relish or Worcestershire sauce
sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

steps: Put all the ingredients in a saucepan and mix well. Place over a medium heat and cook for 5 minutes, stirring, or until piping hot throughout.
Serve with a main of your choice.

TIPS: Try adding a little chilli powder or hot sauce for some heat. Don’t confuse onion granules for onion salt – the dish will be far too salty if you use the wrong one! The same applies to garlic granules.
notes: SWAP THIS: You could use a regular tin of baked beans instead of haricot beans in this dish. Just reduce the passata to 250g and leave out the sweetener. Remember it will increase the calories a little, to about 204 kcal per serving.
